text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her victory in the Kikuka Sho, 
Narita Brian had grown far more formidable 
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she and Hishi Amazon reaffirmed 
their promise to battle it out at the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian sets her sights on the Arima 
Kinen. To settle the score with Hishi 
Amazon—!
